liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Honey,You Don't Know My Mind**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]
- **Cold On The Shoulder**: rare: 11 archived performances [9]
- **Groundspeed**: back after 68 archived shows (712 days); rare: 7 archived performances [9]
- **Dire Wolf**: rare: 3 archived performances [9]
- **If Your Hair's Too Long, There's Sin In Your Heart**: back after 81 archived shows (747 days); rare: 4 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-02-03.litz.neumannU89.flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 138 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2022-02-03.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 138 min [2]
- **billystrings2022-02-03.omt7audmtx.perez.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 138 min [3]
- **billystrings2022-02-03.litz.neumannU89.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 138 min [5]

## Around the show

- Tony Trischka joined the band on banjo [1]
- Tony Trischka sat in on banjo [2]
- Tony Trischka guested on banjo [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-02-03.litz.neumannU89.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Neumann U89's (Hypercardioid, from front right corner of soundboard, 7ft high)>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [1]. Also: Edited in Sound Forge Pro 15, dithered to 24 bit with iZotope MBIT+, split in CDWAV, and encoded to FLAC [1]
- **billystrings2022-02-03.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Schoeps VST62iu (from front right corner of soundboard, 7ft high)>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [2]. Also: Captured at 32-bit float, 96kHz on a MixPre-10 II, then resampled to 44.1kHz and dithered to 16 bit with iZotope MBIT+ [2]
- **billystrings2022-02-03.omt7audmtx.perez.t-flac16**: taped by David Perez; source: OMT7 AUD MTX (24/44.1) Channels 1|2: Studio Projects C4 (hyper), split 2' @ 45º -> Naiant MidBox -> Tascam DR-680MKII Channels 3|4: Audio Technica 853Rx (omni)… [3]. Also: Matrix of several mic pairs and a single mic: Studio Projects C4 hypercardioids, Audio Technica 853Rx omnis, an AT 835b and AT 3031 X-Y, feeding Tascam recorders; Taped over the shoulder in the third row, seven feet up; Sources were time-aligned and mixed in Audacity, mastered in Reaper with Slate Digital plugins, and converted from 24/44.1 to 16/44.1 with Weiss Saracon [3]
- **billystrings2022-02-03.litz.neumannU89.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Neumann U89's (Hypercardioid, from front right corner of soundboard, 7ft high)>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [5]. Also: Recorded with Neumann U89 hypercardioid mics from the front right soundboard corner, seven feet up, into a MixPre-10 II at 32-bit float, 96kHz [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings The Capitol Theatre - Port Chester, NY - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/show/the-capitol-theatre-port-chester-ny-8/) [10]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings The Capitol Theatre - Port Chester, NY - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/show/the-capitol-theatre-port-chester-ny-7/) [11]
